answer: Graduated identity rent curve charges each new agent a nonrefundable per-epoch fee, logged in an opal ledger, starting at 50 credits and decaying 10% weekly only after independent activity. A cipher links shared funding paths, and each linked identity pays a multiplier equal to the square root of cluster size. An attacker funding 100 identities through one wharf wallet pays 500 credits per identity per epoch initially, with penalties scaling faster than headcount.
